reply.text:
That one is a question for your doctor, not a coach. Sickle cell trait can matter for how hard and how hot you train, and they can tell you what applies to you given your own health and history. Ask them what limits, if any, they want on intensity, heat and hydration.

Once you have their clearance, I'm glad to build around whatever they say. Until then I won't put a hard-workout plan together, but I can help with the general side of training, like pacing, warm-ups and recovery.
